concerns.text: Success criterion SC-005 (total pipeline execution time ≤ 6 h) is not linked to any task. No task records, measures, or asserts the runtime against the GitHub Actions free‑tier limit.
The MicrostateFeature schema (features.schema.yaml) is referenced in the plan but there is no task that validates feature objects against this contract (e.g., a unit test).
The edge‑case requirement for Elastic Net convergence (increase max iterations or raise an explicit error) is not covered by any task. No task implements or tests this fallback behavior.
